spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

twap_derived_from_history.meaning: time-weighted average is derived from historical cumulative price data rather than the current spot tradePrice

swap_executed_at_manipulated_price.meaning: subsequent swaps or liquidity removals execute at attacker-determined manipulated prices

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked to check the price for a subsequent swap or liquidity action (validate_price_called).
The manipulated spot price is transient and attacker-controlled before the swap.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call validatePrice or whether the attacker is permissionless; the applicability scope of the guard is not fully specified.
No concrete amounts, percentages, or numeric slippage-limit figures are given, so the slippage-limit comparison is represented only qualitatively.

limitations: Whether the manipulated swap actually executes is conditional (can/may), not observed; the impact is encoded as a potential execution outcome.
The TWAP derivation and slippage-limit relation are represented as grounded Boolean observables because the report gives no numeric cumulative-price or elapsed-time values.
